title: Tony Pollard: I'm still progressing after four straight 1,000-yard seasons

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Tony Pollard: I'm still progressing after four straight 1,000-yard seasons
sources.description: There's not much physical resemblance between running backs Derrick Henry and Tony Pollard, but Pollard has proven to be a capable replacement for Henry in the Titans' backfield.
